verdict.rationale: gstack is a local skill and agent toolkit that also collects telemetry, so where its data is stored is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The pack contains no documented region or residency selection. Local learnings files under ~/.gstack and the telemetry opt-out are adjacent behaviors, not a choice of storage region, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
